name: Pharmeasy
description: The working clone of "PharmEasy", which delivers medicines and other healthcare items.

paragraphs: This is the Construct Week Group Project of PharmEasy clone using HTML CSS and JavaScript.

The working clone of "Take it easy, Pharmeasy", which delivers medicines and other healthcare items, now available via prescriptions. To build this clone we have used HTML5, CSS3, Advanced Javascript. Alongside doing this project, we learnt a lot of new things about team work, proper coordination and thinking along with all the team members. This was our first basic project using basic tools at Masai School. More amazing projects to come ..😊
Products can be sorted from low to high or high to low, on sidebar products can be selected based on price range
features: We have to Open index.html file on the live server(using VS code live server)
On landing page User have to click on Login
The user gets 2 ways to add the product to the cart one by searching the required product name in the search bar of the landing page
Another way of adding products to the cart is by clicking on health-care products, a list of categories will be opened
On clicking any categories a filter page opens, a list of products related to that category appears
